text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer.
This injury is all my fault...
choice_data_list: It's not that bad of an injury.
It's not that bad of an injury.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Naturally, the injury is not an issue. I am not one to be stopped by something of this magnitude.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yet... I have caused you
to wear such a sorrowful expression...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I, who swore to bring happiness to all creation!
To think I cast a shadow over the heart of the one beside me...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I'll show you!
A fierce, unyielding run that laughs in the face of injury.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And without fail—
I will bring peace to your heart!
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's get some rest, then.
Yeah. Let's get some rest, then.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And without fail—
I will bring peace to your heart!
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's get some rest, then.
Yeah. Let's get some rest, then.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
W-Were you listening to what I was saying?!
I was just trying to reassure you, I--

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
――Aha!
Could it be, you're trying to say this?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "I want to become T.M. Opera O's roost. That would be the supreme bliss"... so it says.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...It frustrates me to halt our advance.
However, this too is my duty, I suppose."

TM Opera O took her rest, seeming once again
fully aware of the weight she carried upon her shoulders...

Indeed, just as she says, I am worried.
Knowing she is in good health would bring great relief!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Alright! Let's head outside right away—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ouuuuch!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh... Heheheh... It seems... the god of the earth... is jealous of my feelings for you... isn't he...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
“What a... sinful guy... I am...
...――*collapses*.”
Having seemingly taken on yet another crime, she required immediate care and attention...

Indeed, just as she says, I am worried.
Knowing she is in good health would bring great relief!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Alright! Let's head outside right away—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Phew... How was my running?
Flawless without a single shadow of doubt, right?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, is that so, is that so!
Those words told me everything you're feeling.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"My heart, deeply moved by the sight of her running, is filled with pure bliss...
Overcome with gratitude, I feel as if I could burst into tears at any moment!"
choice_data_list: No, I didn't burst into tears or anything—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is fine! No words of gratitude are necessary.
After all, I have already received mine.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes! That smile of yours... see?!
I had a lot I wanted to say to her as she basked in her own accomplishments... but either way, her injury seemed to be doing well, so I let it slide.
